PremiumTerminalShader - iTerm2 Background Shader Engine
Build Date: 2026-05-26
Version: 0.7.1 (MILESTONE 7 - All Integration Issues Fixed)

FIXES IN THIS BUILD:
✅ Fixed iTerm2 background integration using AppleScript
✅ Fixed "frame_temp.png couldn't be moved" errors
✅ Fixed keyboard shortcuts conflicting with iTerm2
✅ Background now appears reliably in iTerm2 windows
✅ Smooth animation without distortion

TECHNICAL CHANGES:
- Changed from OSC 50 escape sequences to AppleScript API calls
- Removed atomic write temp file (eliminated file move errors)
- Updated keyboard shortcuts to avoid iTerm2 conflicts:
  • Cmd+Shift+1 - Cycle presets (was Cmd+1)
  • Cmd+Shift+O - Open settings (was Cmd+,)
  • Cmd+Option+O - Alternative settings shortcut
- Reduced background update rate to 30 FPS for better performance
- Added comprehensive logging for troubleshooting

KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS (NEW):
- Cmd+Shift+1 : Cycle through presets
- Cmd+Shift+O : Open settings panel
- Cmd+Option+O : Open settings panel (alternative)
- Any key : Triggers subtle typing reaction

SUPPORTED PRESETS:
1. Spaceflight - 3D starfield with depth and motion
2. Night Sky Flight - Volumetric night cloudscape
3. Morning Sky Flight - Bright dawn cloudscape
4. Ocean Wave Flight - 3D ocean waves with perspective
5. Evening Sky Flight - Sunset atmosphere

INSTALLATION:
1. Extract the .tar.gz file
2. Move PremiumTerminalShader.app to /Applications
3. Open iTerm2 (not Terminal.app - won't work in other terminals)
4. Run: /Applications/PremiumTerminalShader.app/Contents/MacOS/PremiumTerminalShader &

Or use the test script: ./test_shortcuts.sh

TESTING:
- Run the daemon in iTerm2 terminal
- Background should appear within 3 seconds
- Press Cmd+Shift+1 to cycle presets
- Press Cmd+Shift+O to open settings
- Type anything to see subtle reaction

VERIFICATION:
- Check iTerm2 Preferences → Profiles → Window → Background Image
- Should show: ~/.config/iTerm2ShaderCLI/frame.png
- Check logs: tail -f /tmp/iterm2shader.log
- Should NOT see "Failed to move frame file" errors

REQUIREMENTS:
- macOS 13.0+ (Ventura)
- iTerm2 3.0.0+ (will NOT work with Terminal.app or other terminals)
- Apple Silicon or Intel Mac
- ~50-70% CPU usage (Metal GPU rendering)

MACOS PERMISSIONS:
If keyboard shortcuts don't work:
1. System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation
2. Enable PremiumTerminalShader → iTerm2
3. System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility
4. Add and enable PremiumTerminalShader

TROUBLESHOOTING:
- Background not showing?
  → Ensure you're running in iTerm2 (not Terminal.app)
  → Check logs: tail -f /tmp/iterm2shader.log
  → Verify daemon is running: ps aux | grep PremiumTerminalShader

- File move errors?
  → Fixed in this version (direct file write)
  → Should not see these errors anymore

- Shortcuts not working?
  → Use Cmd+Shift+1 and Cmd+Shift+O (not Cmd+1 and Cmd+,)
  → Check macOS Automation permissions
  → Watch logs: tail -f /tmp/iterm2shader.log | grep "Keyboard shortcut"

DOCUMENTATION:
- FIXES_APPLIED.md - Summary of all fixes

- KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS.md - Shortcut reference and troubleshooting

PERFORMANCE:
- Frame rendering: 60 FPS at 2880x1800
- Background updates: 30 FPS (AppleScript sync)
- CPU usage: 50-70% (Metal + PNG encoding + AppleScript)
- Smooth animation, no flickering, no distortion

KNOWN ISSUES:
- None! All reported issues fixed in this build.
